```python
def _subtree(leaves, lo, hi, target, path):
    # builds perfect subtree over leaves[lo:hi] (hi-lo power of two)
    if hi - lo == 1:
        return leaves[lo]
    mid = (lo+hi)//2
    if target < mid:
        left = _subtree(leaves, lo, mid, target, path)
        right = _subtree(leaves, mid, hi, None, path)
        path.append(("R", right))       # need right sibling
        return _h(b"\x01"+left+right)
    else:
        left = _subtree(leaves, lo, mid, None, path)
        right = _subtree(leaves, mid, hi, target, path)
        path.append(("L", left))
        return _h(b"\x01"+left+right)
```
